findings.title: Path parameter name mismatch breaks routing
findings.description: VishwasApiService.kt uses {sessionId} in @POST("voice-detection/stream/{sessionId}/chunk") and @DELETE("voice-detection/stream/{sessionId}"), but the backend routes expect {session_id}. Change both Retrofit paths to {session_id} to match the backend's FastAPI route definitions.

findings.title: ViewModel cleanup missing
findings.description: VishwasViewModel does not override onCleared() to cancel streaming coroutines or delete backend sessions. When the ViewModel is destroyed (process death, ViewModel scope cleared), active sessions leak until the 30-minute TTL. Override onCleared() and track the active sessionId to call stopVoiceStreaming() before clearing.

findings.title: Stale waveform persists across sessions
findings.description: waveformData state is not reset when transitioning from Complete/Error to a new session. The "Start New Session" button resets the state machine but not the waveform array. Reset waveformData = FloatArray(100) { 0f } in the same button handler or when starting recording.

findings.title: Partial chunk dropped at session end
findings.description: Accumulated bytes (0-47999) are discarded when recording stops. The plan documents this as intentional (matching React frontend), but the UI info card does not mention it. Users might expect the last 1-2 seconds to be analyzed. Add a note to the info card: "Audio is processed in ~1.5s chunks; the final partial chunk is not analyzed."
